identity.name: PROGET ALIMENTATION
identity.mission: Bringing the authentic taste of Mali to every table.

primary.description: Mali Green - Use for primary actions, success states, and brand identity.

secondary.description: Mali Yellow - Use for highlights, stars, accents, and 'fresh' indicators.

destructive.description: Mali Red - Use for 'Heat/Fire' effects, discounts, urgency, and delete actions.

background.description: Warm Stone White - Avoid pure white to maintain an organic feel.

headings.description: Bold, modern, and friendly. Use for all major headers.

accent.description: Use sparingly for 'FLYER STYLE' big promo text (e.g., 'PROMO', '-50%').

rules: Use 'Fire Gradient' for Hero backgrounds or Promo banners.
Product cards must use white background with subtle shadow.
Category headers should be bold and centered.
Status badges: Green (In Stock), Red (Low Stock/Out), Yellow (Pending).

buttons.primary: bg-[#14B53A] hover:bg-[#109630] text-white font-bold rounded-full shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300
buttons.fire: bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-red-600 text-white font-black uppercase tracking-widest shadow-fire hover:scale-105 transition-transform

cards.product: bg-white border border-stone-100 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-hover transition-shadow duration-300 group
cards.feature: bg-stone-50 border-none rounded-xl p-6 hover:bg-white transition-colors

visual_enhancers.fire_effect: Use a subtle bottom border gradient or background gradient on 'Hot' sections using the 'fire' gradient defined in colors.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a very subtle noise texture opacity-5 on the main background to give it a paper/flyer feel.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'Lucide React' icons. For food specific icons, try to find the closest match or use generic shapes.

universal_guidelines: Always use the 'data-testid' attribute for interactive elements.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use #1C1917 or #0C0A09.
Ensure all text over images has a 'bg-black/40' overlay or sufficient text shadow.
Buttons must have a distinct hover state.
Forms must use Shadcn components (Input, Select, Form).
Mobile responsiveness is PRIORITY 1. Check everything at 375px width.
implementation_steps: Step 1: Update 'tailwind.config.js' with the new color palette (primary, secondary, destructive, accent).
Step 2: Install necessary fonts (Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, Bebas Neue) via Google Fonts in 'index.css'.
Step 3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Navbar (with Mali flag strip top border) and Footer.
Step 4: Build the 'ProductCard' component with the image, price (Euro/CFA), and 'Add to Cart' button.
Step 5: Build the 'Hero' section with the 'Fire' gradient and bold typography.
Step 6: Implement the Admin Dashboard using a Sidebar layout and Data Tables.
